theme.archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & TACTICAL PRECISION

headings.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase

monospace.family: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace
monospace.usage: Job Numbers (e.g., 26207), Unit IDs (W1, W2, D1, BF1, SL1), PO Numbers (26207-PO-01), Dimensions (W x H), Financial Amounts

app_header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between
app_header.brand: Apex Craft Fabrication | Manufacturing Operations & Shop Floor Tracking

layout_and_navigation.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8 for cards; gap-4 to gap-6 for grid layouts
layout_and_navigation.grid_system: High density Grid (MODE B) - Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4

login_page.description: Clean industrial splash page with custom window/door shop imagery and simple email/password auth.

jobs_list_page.description: Grid of Job cards with 5-digit job ID (YYNNN, e.g. 26207), customer/name, status badge, Sold vs PO spend progress bar, unit breakdown pill counts.
features: Search & filter by Job # or Customer

job_detail_page.description: Comprehensive job detail view with 4 tabs: Specs Sheet, Units Table, Purchase Orders, Movement History.
job_detail_page.po_summary: Auto PO calculation: Sold Amount - Sum(PO Totals) = Remaining Budget. Visual highlight if over-budget.

tv_mode.description: Large-screen Wall Display Mode (10-15m viewing distance). High contrast, 1.5x larger font sizes, clear unit tags, auto-refresh indicator every 15s, fullscreen toggle (F11/button).
card_elements: Vendor name if Out for Process

in_out_tracker.description: Facility check-out & check-in system for secondary processing (Welding, Painting, Powder Coating, Anodizing).

vendors_page.description: CRUD management table and card view for external processing vendors (Welding, Painting, Glazing, Anodizers).

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based. MANDATORY on all buttons, links, inputs, cards, status badges, and tabs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as configured in the frontend application.
Maintain strict high contrast dark theme for shop-floor TV readability.
Always validate PO costs deducted from Job sold amount and display remaining budget alerts.
Ensure complete data-testid attributes on every interactive element.
